description: Compare two OpenAPI versions and classify every change as breaking, non-breaking, or an addition — at path, operation, parameter, request-body, and response granularity.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

new.description: The CANDIDATE version to compare against the baseline. Aliases: `to`, `revision`.

old.description: The BASELINE version of the document. Aliases: `from`, `base`.

name: diff_api_versions
